_comment: EXAMPLE. Copy to llm_providers.json and edit — the real file is gitignored.
A provider is a (base_url, key NAME) pair, NOT a vendor. Holding two token
plans with the same vendor needs no code: register it twice under different
names with different api_key_env and list both in a route's rotate pool —
the spent-window cooldown keys on provider/model, so the plans park apart.
The KEY ITSELF never appears here: only the name of the file to read it from.
